campaigns.rationale: Targets the professional end of the market - detailers, body shops and car washes in Qatar who buy cut-and-finish compounds and bulk shampoo as repeat consumables, and search by cut stage or by SKU number. Kept separate from the retail protection themes because the intent is trade restocking, the copy leads on paint-correction workflow, and the negatives have to fight a completely different homonym set (compound = residential compound, polish = Poland, power cut = electricity outage).

notes:
PRE-IMPORT CHECKS AND JUDGEMENT CALLS.

1. PRICE LEAK IN THE CATALOGUE, NOT IN THESE ADS. catalogue.json product `autotriz-one-step-finish` carries `Price=QAR 280 (Box rate: QAR 250 each)` in its specs string. That contradicts the site-wide no-prices rule and means the One Step Finish landing page may publish a price while every other page does not. No price appears in any asset here, but the owner should decide whether that spec line stays live before the One Step ad group is enabled - an ad that says 'ask on WhatsApp for a quote' pointing at a page showing QAR 280 is an ad/LP inconsistency.

2. 20 L IS ONLY TRUE FOR THE SHAMPOO. The theme brief said to lean on 20 L availability, but catalogue.json only states 20 L for Rich Foam Shampoo (Briller's line is also 20 L). Power Cut 701 and One Step Finish are 4 L; Heavy Cut 901 and Ultimate Polish 302 state no size at all. So no compound ad claims 20 L and no compound keyword targets it. If the compounds genuinely ship in 20 L, confirm the pack sizes and add `polishing compound 20 litre qatar` / `شامبو ومعجون بالجملة` style bulk terms afterwards.

3. 'MADE IN GERMANY' IS RESTRICTED TO THE SHAMPOO AD GROUP. catalogue.json states Origin=Made in Germany for Rich Foam Shampoo (and PPF Gel, REVO, ION+) but states no origin for 901, 701, 302 or One Step Finish. The claim is therefore used in the shampoo ads only. Do not let it drift onto the compound ad groups.

4. 'POWER CUT' IS AN ELECTRICITY-OUTAGE HOMONYM. This is the single biggest waste risk in the theme and the research brief did not flag it. Every Power Cut keyword carries the SKU number 701, and the ad group negatives block power cut today / power cut in / power outage / electricity / kahramaa. Do not add a bare `power cut` keyword.

5. 'COMPOUND' IS A QATARI REAL-ESTATE WORD. compound villa / compound for rent / compound house / family compound are in the shared negatives. Watch the search terms report for other rental phrasings in week 1.

6. 'NEAR ME' IS DELIBERATELY NOT A BLANKET NEGATIVE, against the research brief's advice. ABK has a physical walk-in shop in Mesaimeer, so `car care products near me` is a genuine retail buyer. Only the service+proximity combinations are blocked (car polishing near me, car detailing near me, car wash near me).

7. NO GCC GEO NEGATIVES AND NO BARE 'INSTALLATION' NEGATIVE, on purpose. assemble.mjs expands every sharedNegatives entry to a campaign negative on EVERY campaign in the account, including other themes' files. Blocking dubai/riyadh/kuwait would break a GCC wholesale campaign, and blocking `installation` would break the Autotriz PPF Gel product, whose own name is 'Installation Aid'. Both campaigns here are location-targeted to Qatar, and every keyword carries qatar/doha or an Autotriz SKU, so geo leakage is already low.

8. CROSS-CAMPAIGN KEYWORD DEDUPE. Briller Wash & Wax is intentionally absent - it belongs to the Briller theme. Bare `car shampoo qatar` was left out for the same reason; this campaign uses purchase-qualified variants (buy car shampoo qatar, bulk car shampoo qatar, professional car shampoo qatar). If the Briller theme also bid bare shampoo head terms, the two campaigns would compete against each other in the same auction.

9. THE ONE KEYWORD TO WATCH: `car polish qatar` (Exact, ad group Finishing Polish 302). Google close variants can pull `car polishing qatar`, which is service intent. It is the only head term in the theme with real service contamination risk - check its search terms after 7 days and pause it if the terms are workshop queries.

10. BID STRATEGY DEPENDS ON A TRACKING STEP THAT IS NOT FINISHED. Both campaigns are set to Maximize conversions to match the shared schema, but Smart Bidding needs conversion signal. src/lib/ads-conversions.ts already implements a `whatsapp` conversion event on tag AW-18200382552, and its own comments record that the tag previously only ever called gtag('config') so zero conversions were ever reported. The per-action conversion LABELS still have to be created in Google Ads and supplied as NEXT_PUBLIC_* env vars, followed by a redeploy, before Maximize conversions can work. Until labels are live, run both campaigns on Maximize clicks with the per-ad-group max CPC as the cap. Note also that wa.me cannot be a Final URL - the display domain must match - so the conversion stays on the on-page WhatsApp button.

11. ARABIC RENDERING. Every Arabic headline opens on an Arabic word, contains no em-dash, no terminal punctuation and no tashkeel, and uses Western digits mid-string only. The Latin brand token 'Autotriz' is always terminal or mid-string, never leading. Preview each Arabic RSA in Google's own ad preview before enabling - a monospace editor hides bidi reordering.

12. ARABIC NEGATIVE SAFETY. `مركز` is never used as a bare negative because Google ignores diacritics and it would collide with مركّز (concentrated) in the shampoo terms; only the full phrases مركز تلميع / خدمة تلميع are blocked. Likewise `تلميع سيارات` is never a bare negative because it is contained inside the best product keyword معجون تلميع سيارات.

13. ASSETS. This schema has no sitelink/callout fields, so add the account-level assets from assets.json. The most useful callouts for this theme are trade supply, walk-in Doha stock, and the supplier-not-workshop positioning.
